before: The final pre-fix regression builds and runs: 1 permanent-error control passes and 4 transient-seek tests fail. Both parsers refuse finite Interrupted faults before/after moving the cursor, during open and full-packet reads. Actual software playback fails on its first injected random-access interruption. Range recovery is verified after the same shared seek fix.
after: 40 selected checks passed, zero failed/ignored: new transient-seek coverage 5, established seek-I/O controls 3, core MP4 20, implicit fragment base 3, open edits 5, time-header flags 2 and sizes 2.
change: A private helper retries ErrorKind::Interrupted at the four seek sites: End(0) size discovery, absolute atom scan, full packet and bounded packet range. Repeating these absolute/end requests also works when an interrupted seek already moved. Existing invalidation, output clearing, admission and permanent-error propagation are unchanged.
media: Owned three distinct colored VP9 keyframes, 50 Hz sample clock, analytic YUV16 oracles; offline generator reuses synthetic construction helpers and produces all eight files byte-identically. A finite fault adapter injects two interruptions; no mutation audit, network or FFmpeg is used.
scope: One interruption-handling problem; wrapper/path/fault-mode/fixture variants add no IDs.
correctness: Root and owned parser opening covers Start and End(0), interrupted before and after cursor movement.
Both full packet and range reads recover exact bytes, then return subsequent packets correctly.
Permanent Other and PermissionDenied faults remain failures, clear full-packet output and permit recovery.
Software Mp4VideoReader matches all authored pixel oracles and 50 Hz PTS/duration through random+contiguous seeks, rewind and repeated EOF.
Existing malformed-input, header, edit, fragmentation and seek-I/O regressions pass.
limitations: Software decoder and seekable synthetic I/O were exercised; no physical disk signal-delivery or NVIDIA/GPU claim.
No project-wide green claim; separate historical Matroska padding/admission/ABI failures remain outside this fix.
